title: Concept: Subversion metadata served from the web root
description: A Subversion entries document from a working copy in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The metadata lists every versioned path and revision, and with the wc.db alongside it an attacker can reconstruct source history that was never meant to ship.
applicability: Deployments that render a Subversion entries document from a working copy into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The metadata lists every versioned path and revision, and with the wc.db alongside it an attacker can reconstruct source history that was never meant to ship.
